messages:
Alex P: Wrapping up deploy for slice-3 — finished at 11:03 PT. Canaries are up (4/4). @Priya M can you eyeball p95 and errors? I'll run a quick smoke checklist.
deploy-bot: release v1.24.3 deployed to prod/slice-3 by Alex P. canaries: 4/4. logs: `deploy logs --id v1.24.3 --site us-west1`
Priya M: p95 steady ~120ms, error-rate 0.08% over last 15m, no obvious spikes vs baseline.
Selena K: Ran `/health` and a tiny inference prompt (short chat). Response valid, no obvious regressions. KV cache warmed on canaries.
Jamal S: Rollback manifest is ready in `infra/releases/rollback-v1.24.2.yaml` and annotated in the runbook. If needed: `kubectl apply -f rollback-v1.24.2.yaml --namespace=prod-slice-3` (I have privileges and can execute if we decide).
Alex P: Thanks. Quick extras: 1) trace tail checks for 5 long requests, 2) tokenization sanity on a couple of long prompts. I'm not seeing error couplings in traces.
Priya M: Adding a temporary alert pin on the console for latency and error-rate, retention bumped to 1h for detailed traces.
release-bot: smoke-checks summary: /health OK, sample-infer OK, traces sampled OK — 3/3 passed. Baseline delta within thresholds.
Selena K: Noted a small tail latency bump for >2k tokens (~+10-15ms) on a single shard; within SLO and consistent with canary noise.
Alex P: Good. Standby posture for 30m. If anything regresses we'll call rollback and @Jamal will run the manifest. Leaving hotpatch contacts: @Jamal S, @Priya M. Thanks all :thumbsup:
Priya M: I'll keep the watch and post if anything drifts. If stable at +30m we'll mark the rollout complete and close the thread.
Jamal S: Standing by. I have the rollback window open and notes in the runbook
